description: iOS-only: geolocation for 'Use my location' (when-in-use only, mobile-app schema §2.7 / FR-16), and denies of the four monitor commands that core:default grants through core:window:default, because tao's iOS monitor lookups abort on the iPhone Duo's inner screen (tao issue 1373) and a deny beats an allow; no app code calls them (frontend/src/lib/iosMonitorLookups.test.ts). The geolocation plugin is not in the Android build because its Android module links Google Play services (android-release schema 4.1 and 4.3); an inactive capability is skipped before its permissions are validated, so this file cannot affect the Android build.
